title: Supreme Court (Justices Manoj Misra, Manmohan; NOIDA v. State of UP, order dated 4 Nov 2026, reported 16 Nov) says a State/UT/district where the Yamuna's water quality deteriorates 'shall be held accountable and penalised'; CPCB to sample at every state/district entry and exit and suggest a fine formula recoverable from polluters and negligent officials; all STPs, CETPs, govt biogas plants to fit tamper-proof smart meters and sensors within one month with live data (24-hour gap presumed non-operation); basin states to name a nodal officer within two weeks; 520 drains; CPCB report: none of Delhi's 37 STPs met all norms; next hearing 13 Jan 2027.
headline: Supreme Court: States Where the Yamuna Gets Dirtier Will Be Penalised
